name: Landhaus Kuen
beschreibung: Landhaus Kuen enjoys a sunny and peaceful setting in Pettneu am Arlberg within Tyrol’s Stanzertal Valley, at the foot of the towering Hoher Riffler. The property features comfortable rooms and self-catering apartments fitted with traditional Tyrolean woodwork and private balconies overlooking the alpine peaks. Guests appreciate the relaxed family ambiance and easy proximity to the world-renowned ski hub of St. Anton am Arlberg. A complimentary ski bus connects seamlessly to the Ski Arlberg lifts in minutes, while summer offers pristine hiking, mountain biking, and climbing routes.
kurzbeschreibung: Charming alpine holiday accommodation in Pettneu am Arlberg near St. Anton am Arlberg with mountain views.
